latest.title: Bespoke Database Query Loader, Security Hardening & Concurrency Fixes
latest.summary: Introduced custom animated database platter query loader, fixed plaintext password exposure on long keys, blocked MySQL executable comment bypasses, fixed statement quote desync, and eliminated ghost shift multi-line editor selections.

highlights.title: Bespoke Database Query Loader
highlights.description: Replaced generic circular spinners with an animated 3-tier database cylinder stack, active index-scan laser beam, and neon glow aura.

highlights.title: Security & Cryptography Hardening
highlights.description: Enforced strict encryption envelopes on passwords of any length and restricted master key permissions to POSIX 0600.

highlights.title: Read-Only Validator & Quote Parser
highlights.description: Blocked MySQL executable comment bypasses and fixed escaped quote handling in SQL statement splitting.

highlights.title: Ghost Shift Click Prevention
highlights.description: Synchronized physical keyboard modifier state via getModifierState to prevent single clicks from creating massive range selections.
